scripts.dev: npm run build:shared && concurrently -k -p "[{name}]" -n "SHARED,API,WEB" -c "yellow,blue,cyan" "npm run dev:shared" "npm run dev:server" "npm run dev:client"
scripts.build: npm run build:shared && npm run build:server && npm run build:client
scripts.typecheck: npm run build:shared && npm run typecheck:shared && npm run typecheck:server && npm run typecheck:client
scripts.test: node -e "console.error('Automated tests are not implemented yet.'); process.exit(1);"
scripts.clean: node -e "const fs = require('fs'); ['shared/dist', 'server/dist', 'client/dist'].forEach(p => fs.rmSync(p, { recursive: true, force: true }));"
